Good to know

Questions brides ask us

How far ahead should I book?

Ideally 6–9 months before your wedding, so there's relaxed time for ordering and alterations. Short on time? We keep rush slots every month and a rail of ready-to-wear gowns that can be tailored in 2–3 weeks.

Is the first fitting really free?

Yes — completely free, with no card details and no obligation to buy. You get a full 90 minutes with your own stylist and up to four guests. If you fall in love with a gown, its price already includes your alteration fittings, steaming and a keepsake garment bag.

Can I pay in parts?

Of course. Reserve your gown with 30%, then spread the rest in monthly payments — everything is interest-free and confirmed in writing before you pay anything.

Do you style the whole bridal party?

Yes — bridesmaids, mothers of the bride and flower girls. Group appointments seat up to six, and package pricing covers parties of two to eight.

What if I change my mind about the style?

It happens, and it's fine. Before your alterations begin, you can swap your gown for another in store at no extra charge — we'd rather you love it completely.
